explication: icloudpd is a command-line iCloud Photos downloader. The main workflow parses options, authenticates the account (including MFA), queries iCloud photo libraries, then downloads and names selected assets on local storage. Copy, sync, move, continuous watch, Live Photo/RAW handling, de-duplication, incremental selection, EXIF updates, and status reporting are additional product capabilities. Edges reflect the README and SOURCE INDEX references; unsampled modules are represented where documented, but their internal call paths are not inferred.
